economy.summary: Briggs's campaign site describes him as working to create an economy that works for everyone.
economy.short: Says he works for an economy that works for everyone.

taxes.summary: Briggs is listed among state legislators supporting the "Tax Billionaires, Fund PA" campaign, which proposes raising state revenue through new taxes on billionaires and corporations.
taxes.short: Supports the Tax Billionaires, Fund PA revenue campaign.

abortion.summary: As chair of the House Judiciary Committee, Briggs advanced a constitutional amendment and bills to protect reproductive rights, stating Pennsylvanians deserve to make personal health care decisions without government interference.
abortion.short: Advanced bills protecting reproductive rights as Judiciary chair.

education.summary: Briggs's campaign site says he has consistently advocated for strong, equitable public education and early childhood education.
education.short: Advocates for equitable public and early childhood education.

energy.summary: Briggs led the "Zero Waste PA" legislative package on waste and recycling and is a founding member of the House Climate Caucus; his campaign site notes he was ranked a top environmental legislator by the Sierra Club.
energy.short: Led Zero Waste PA package; founding House Climate Caucus member.

guns.summary: Briggs's campaign site says he has introduced bills to protect children from accessing firearms.
guns.short: Introduced bills to protect children from accessing firearms.
